notes_for_editor: Thin record. Both Forest Fire Lookout Association lists give the name, county, coordinates and status, and nothing more. No Forest Lookouts (centraluslookouts) page exists for this site, and the nav of its Texas index has no Vidor or Terry entry. The name's parenthetical 'Terry' is not explained by any source checked, so the story does not explain it. Searches of the Portal to Texas History for 'Terry lookout' Vidor returned two unrelated items. TopoZone's Orange County tower list is empty. The Vidor paragraph is place context from TSHA and does not say the tower stood near the town. No build date, height, agency, staffing or fire record found. Story body is 99 words after the fact-check. It stays short because no source describes the tower, and no claim was added to reach 120 words. The story no longer says the name points to Vidor; it says only that no source checked ties the tower to the town.
